descriptor: Outdoor kit shop for all weathers

voice.summary: Talks like a shop owner who has been out in the rain and says so: practical, a little wry and honest about gear. Sentences are short and boots-on-the-ground.
dos: Name the weather or terrain in the copy
Recommend gear by what it does, not what it is
donts: Never pretend a forecast is a promise

taglines: Kit for whatever the forecast says
Gear that's been out in it
Out the door, prepared for anything
boilerplate: Harborlight Outfitters is an independent outdoor kit shop supplying jackets, boots and camp gear to people who go outside whatever the forecast says.

microcopy.success: You're on the list. See you fortnightly.
microcopy.error: That didn't go through. Check your email and retry.
microcopy.empty: Nothing in your bag yet. Time to gear up.

logo.note: A mountain peak is the simplest sign of hills, weather and getting outside.
